requirements.description: A university student residence needs schools and universities nearby. Proximity is implied by the project type, so the threshold is set at the 75th percentile of the education distribution (75.14, rounded to 75).

The user prefers energy class C or better, so the filter includes classes A1 through A4, B and C. Floor area (850 sqm), capacity (60 people), Turin location and the CDP/PNRR program are not energy columns and are not filtered here.
The user explicitly specifies a gross floor area of at least 850 sqm.

output.sql: SELECT * FROM ESTATES WHERE property_type = 'Uffici e assimilabili' AND surface_area >= 850 AND energy_class IN ('A1', 'A2', 'A3', 'A4', 'B', 'C') AND education >= 75 AND haversine_km(latitude, longitude, 45.0677551, 7.6824892) <= 3.0 ORDER BY haversine_km(latitude, longitude, 45.0677551, 7.6824892) ASC
output.explanation: Filters on office-type properties (property_type 'Uffici e assimilabili') with surface_area >= 850, energy_class in A1-A4/B/C, education score >= 75, and a 3.0 km haversine radius around (45.0677551, 7.6824892). Results are ordered by distance from that point. The 60-person capacity is not an extracted requirement, so it is not filtered.
